name: Arce (Italy)
description: White field with a border of yellow and blue segments, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Arce (a yellow castle on blue above green) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Arce, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 11 September 1996.
